seed_codes.0: full-spectrum CPU QZ at this point

backend_meta.residual_definition: temporal: ||(A - c B) x||_2 / ||x||_2 / ((||A||_F + |c| ||B||_F) / nn); spatial: ||(C0 + a C1 + a^2 C2) phi||_2 / ||phi||_2 / ((||C0||_F + |a| ||C1||_F + |a|^2 ||C2||_F) / nn)  (the deployed _filter_with_residual normalization); operators re-assembled in FP64 by the exact deployed assembly code.
backend_meta.edge_ratio_definition: mean over the top n_edge=4 collocation points (freestream side, index 0) of max-over-state-blocks |phi|, divided by the global peak of the same profile amplitude (pymack.api._edge_ratio generalized to any block count); small values indicate a freestream-decaying discrete mode.
